title: Peace Breakdowns and the Space X Effect
summary: Iran bargaining, Space X valuation and Strategy liquidity.
assessment: The strongest analysis separates asset backing from cash obligations and identifies expensive equity as useful financing currency. Some historical and engineering examples are inaccurate. Conditional geopolitical scenarios remain distinct from completed forecasts, while the observed rate hike does not validate a probability estimate.

claims.reason: The conditional transmission channel is sound, but negotiations, shipping, inventories and demand interact. Subsequent prolonged Gulf production outages support disruption risk; they do not isolate negotiation failure as the cause of observed prices.

claims.claim: Obama-era enrichment was already weapons grade.
claims.reason: The historical comparison overstates the earlier enrichment level. claims.claim: Orbital computing faces substantial engineering barriers.
claims.reason: Launch, repair and heat rejection are real constraints. NASA explains that vacuum eliminates convection, requiring radiative heat rejection. The Webb example overstates practical servicing: NASA explicitly says Webb is not serviceable like Hubble. The source argues that valuable telescopes can justify maintenance, rather than literally claiming Webb was designed for servicing. Cold space does not automatically make cooling easy.

evidence.title: Spacecraft thermal control
evidence.finding: Vacuum requires conduction within the spacecraft and radiation to reject heat; convection is absent.

evidence.title: Webb frequently asked questions
evidence.finding: Webb was not designed to be serviceable at its distant L 2 orbit.

claims.claim: AI spending drains hyperscaler free cash flow.
claims.reason: The capex drain is real, but the blanket claim that most hyperscalers are already negative is too broad without a company universe and period. Subsequent Q2 results show Alphabet FCF -$5.9bn while Meta remained positive $784m; Alphabet’s trailing-year FCF was positive $53.3bn. Later results support compression, not the exact already-negative assertion at publication.

evidence.title: Alphabet Q2 earnings call
evidence.finding: Q2 operating cash flow $39.1bn and FCF -$5.9bn; trailing-year FCF remained positive $53.3bn. Cloud revenue grew 82%.

evidence.title: Meta Q2 results
evidence.finding: Operating cash flow $31.86bn, capex including finance-lease principal $31.08bn, and FCF positive $784m.

claims.next_check: Compare the remaining hyperscalers on the same quarter, including finance-lease principal and commitments.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: A scenario tree needs observable triggers and a deadline.
A correct economic mechanism does not identify the cause of a particular market move.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
The article contains a chairmanship-date inconsistency in background prose; it is not treated as an investment thesis.
